title: Super Pi project settings
description: Editor assistance for <project>/.sp/config/settings.json. Loaded only after project trust is granted. Nested fields merge over global settings; arrays replace global values. This file cannot grant trust or override global-only settings.

powershellStatus.description: Global-only: Super Pi maintains this discovery state in global settings.

defaultProjectTrust.description: Global-only: a project cannot grant itself trust.

httpProxy.description: Global-only: startup reads the proxy from global settings.
